timing_scope: Resident model; request start through CPU maps/scores written and closed as .npy files. Includes image decode/preprocess, transfers, complete-pool inference, RsCIN, shape/finite checks and output serialization to OS-buffered local storage. First request includes first-use kernel setup; no discarded warmup. No ground-truth reads, quality metrics, network transport or camera acquisition. Cumulative session time also includes inter-request instrumentation/cleanup.

plan.manifest_definition: SHA256 of ordered relative image paths and byte sizes; not image-content hashes

protocol: original/GPU then GPU/original; fresh process each session; resident model within session
limitations: Repeated same complete pool, not unique production parts or larger reference pools.
Finite saturated workstation replay, not factory deployment or long-duration reliability.
OS disk caches not flushed; buffered output close is not durable fsync.
No camera, network, PLC or actual production arrivals; all requests ready at session start.
No inference feature caching; only model weights and runtime allocations remain resident.
